Print method for bl_local_result

print.bl_local_result.Rd

Prints, in order: the search summary (best pair, selector, distances, prediction at the counterfactual); the Target and Counterfactual blocks; the per-pair distances; and, when a solution was found, a table comparing the observed and counterfactual value of each feature with its change and its set_filters constraint. Values are in original (raw) units when a scaling was set via bl_set_scaling, otherwise in model units. When the search moved a "fixed" feature and the restored point is the counterfactual, a Fixed restored line and a note under the table explain why. When an "integer" feature was rounded, an Integer rounded line and a second note give the boundary value and the whole value chosen. When the restore or the rounding failed, no counterfactual is reported and the Reason line explains it (see Fixed constraints and Integer features in bl_find_local_cf).

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bl_local_result'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A "bl_local_result" object.

...

Currently ignored.

Details

Numbers print in fixed notation with 2 decimals; a feature whose change would print as 0.00 gets more decimals (up to 4) in its row, and the Target and Counterfactual blocks use the same decimals as the table.
